title: b7z9.16.1(b): wire send_dao to the DAO TX scheduler (retries + refresh)
description: Second slice of b7z9.16.1: drive RplStack TX through the DAO scheduler from (a) — send_dao fires when the scheduler reports due; retry ladder advances DaoRetryBackoff (4/8/16s) on failure/retransmit; refresh re-emits at DaoRefreshTimer (900s). Tests: controllable clock driving join -> initial (0-2s) -> send -> retry ladder -> refresh, boundaries from the dao_timing constants.
